characters.summary: Flint Marko can transform his entire body into and manipulate a massive quantity of sand, granting him immense physical strength, density, and modularity in combat. He fights primarily through close-quarters bludgeoning, throwing abrasive sandstorms, and reshaping his limbs into dense hammers or spikes.

mechanisms: Body dispersion to avoid kinetic impacts
Regeneration by absorbing surrounding sand or earth

weaknesses: Vulnerability to water which clumps his sand and restricts his movement and cohesion
limitations: Becomes sluggish and immobilized when completely drenched in water

sources.supports: General character abilities and vulnerabilities across film and comic adaptations

feats.claim: Absorbed massive quantities of sand and grew to towering proportions to fight Spider-Man.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill before mutual reconciliation.

conditional.dependsOn: Presence of loose sand or earth nearby

campaignTags.claim: Can grow into a giant towering sand monster.

unknowns: Exact limits on the maximum volume of sand he can control simultaneously.

characters.continuity: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
characters.summary: Corrupted by the Darkhold, Wanda operates with ruthless efficiency, utilizing dreamwalking, reality warping, and lethal magical constructs. She uses psychic projection across dimensions and decimates entire teams with effortless telekinesis and energy blasts.
weaknesses: Destruction of the physical copy of the Darkhold disrupts her spell momentum
limitations: Vulnerable to emotional appeals regarding her children
characters.formDifferences: Significantly more aggressive, lethal, and durable due to Darkhold corruption, gaining dreamwalking and advanced multiversal casting.

sources.supports: Darkhold-empowered feats and abilities in Multiverse of Madness

feats.claim: Defeated the Illuminati of Earth-838 with overwhelming telekinetic force.
feats.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)

notableResults.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
notableResults.note: Invaded his mental plane and killed him.

conditional.ability: Multiversal dreamwalking and heightened reality warping
conditional.dependsOn: The Darkhold text and mountain temple

campaignTags.claim: Empowered by the Darkhold to cast advanced chaos magic.
Opens dimensional paths using the Darkhold.
Uses dreamwalking to control alternate bodies.

unknowns: Whether her physical body truly perished beneath Mount Wundagore.

characters.id: mcu:Scarlet Witch|House of M Scarlet Witch
characters.continuity: Marvel Comics (House of M continuity adaptation)
characters.summary: Possessing planetary-scale reality warping, this version can rewrite entire timelines and strip superhuman powers globally with a single phrase.
weaknesses: Mentally unstable and susceptible to psychological manipulation by family members
limitations: Prone to severe psychological trauma and catatonia following massive reality rewrites
characters.formDifferences: Possesses planetary and universal reality alteration capabilities vastly exceeding standard cinematic manifestations.

feats.claim: Altered the entire Earth timeline into a mutant-dominant world and depowered millions of mutants with three words.

notableResults.note: Reshaped reality around all heroes simultaneously.

unknowns: Exact trigger mechanisms for her mental breakdowns.

characters.summary: Grounded in her magical origins tied to Mount Wundagore and the Elder God Chthon, she channels primal earth and chaos magic for curses and hex spheres.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to anti-magic fields and bindings tied to Mount Wundagore
limitations: Magic output fluctuates based on mystical exhaustion
characters.formDifferences: Emphasizes traditional spellcasting and ties to Chthon rather than modern cinematic chaos magic.

feats.claim: Channelled the ambient magical energy of Wundagore to repel demonic entities.

campaignTags.claim: Born under magical circumstances at Mount Wundagore.
Casts complex magical rituals and hexes.

unknowns: The exact nature of Chthon's dormant influence over her bloodline.

characters.summary: Robert Reynolds possesses the power of a million exploding suns, granting him godlike physical strength, invulnerability, super-speed, and photokinetic energy projection. He fights as a powerhouse brawler capable of leveling landscapes with casual blows.
weaknesses: Severe psychological instability and agoraphobia linked to his alter ego, the Void
limitations: Power levels fluctuate wildly based on his mental stability and self-doubt

sources.supports: Core abilities, powers of a million suns, and psychological traits

feats.claim: Ripped Carnage in half and threw him into outer space.

notableResults.note: Easily overpowered him by ripping through his molecular structure.

unknowns: The true upper limit of his reality manipulation sub-powers.

characters.summary: Empowered by a Celestial Death Seed, Sentry channels cosmic and death-based energies with zero psychological restraint, allowing him to contend directly with Celestials and planetary threats.
weaknesses: Dependent on the Death Seed's corruption; can be overwhelmed by high-tier cosmic entities
limitations: Subject to the command of whoever controls the Apocalypse Twins or equivalent cosmic anchors
characters.formDifferences: Removes human psychological hesitation, operating with ruthless cosmic authority and enhanced Celestial durability.

sources.supports: Death Seed Sentry incarnation and Uncanny Avengers feats

feats.claim: Tear a Celestial apart in mid-air.

unknowns: Long-term stability of the Death Seed within a mortal vessel.

characters.summary: The dark counterpart and repressed half of Robert Reynolds, The Void can manipulate darkness, reshape its physical form into monstrous giants, and unleash city-wide plagues and storms.
weaknesses: Weakens when Robert Reynolds acknowledges his sanity and integrates his psyche
limitations: Bound to the life force and mental state of Robert Reynolds
characters.formDifferences: Replaces golden heroic aesthetics with black shadowy monstrous forms, gaining dark elemental control and immense size-shifting.

sources.supports: The Void persona and dark entity feats

feats.claim: Pummeled Ares, the Greek god of war, and ripped him in half.

notableResults.note: Killed by Thor after Iron Man dropped the Helicarrier on him and Reynolds regained control.

conditional.ability: Complete manifestation of dark apocalyptic storms

campaignTags.claim: Transforms into a towering monstrous entity.

unknowns: Exact boundaries between Sentry and Void minds.

characters.summary: An immortal Eternal with the ability to transmutate matter on contact or at close range. Sersi fights defensively and creatively, turning hostile objects into water, crystal, or harmless materials.
weaknesses: Cannot transmute sentient organic life forms without touching them directly or requiring massive energy output
limitations: Requires physical proximity or direct line of sight for complex molecular transformations

sources.supports: Sersi's transmutation powers and Eternal feats in the MCU

feats.claim: Transmutated a falling meteor into flower petals and turned a Deviant into a tree.

notableResults.note: Briefly subdued him using transmutation during their final confrontation.

campaignTags.claim: Levitates and flies using cosmic energy.

unknowns: The absolute limit of mass she can transmute simultaneously.

characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe (Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings)
characters.summary: A master martial artist trained from childhood, Shang-Chi combines fluid hand-to-hand combat styles with the mystical Ten Rings, allowing him to project energy blasts, create shields, and deliver devastating strikes.
weaknesses: Relies on physical conditioning and tactical positioning; lacks innate superhuman durability without the rings
limitations: Must maintain precise mental concentration to command multiple rings effectively in combat

sources.supports: Shang-Chi combat style and Ten Rings usage

feats.claim: Defeated the Dweller-in-Darkness with a combined strike using the Ten Rings and traditional martial arts.

notableResults.citation: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)
notableResults.note: Disarmed his father and claimed control of the Ten Rings.

conditional.dependsOn: Possession and mastery of the Ten Rings

unknowns: The origin signal transmitted by the Ten Rings at the film's conclusion.
